api: libvlc_media_new_path(local MP4 path); libvlc_media_parse_with_options(libvlc_media_parse_local); libvlc_media_get_meta(Title); libvlc_media_tracks_get; libvlc_media_get_duration, called from a C++17 translation unit
coverage: LLVM source coverage in VLC's own MP4 demuxer plugin (modules/demux/mp4: libmp4.c box parser, mp4.c demuxer, essetup.c track setup, meta.c metadata), built from the pinned VLC source with static libvlccore and libVLC and called through libvlc_media_parse_with_options on a local file from a C++17 byte-input harness
parser_family: VLC native MP4 demuxer plugin. libvlccore is built without dynamic plugins and the harness registers only the filesystem access and mp4 demuxer plugins through vlc_static_modules, so no other demuxer can claim the input
shared_parser_family: VLC 3.0.24 native MP4 demuxer plugin (modules/demux/mp4) behind the libVLC media API
shared_parser_family_note: Same pinned source archive, configure options, static libvlccore/libVLC build, and statically registered filesystem and mp4 plugins as projects/mp4/c/vlc. Only the call site differs (C++17 with RAII ownership); this is not an independent parser.
